title: HtmlBody
responsibility: Renders the native body element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlBody.attributes
inputs.description: Native body attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlBody.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native body element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlBody
outputs.description: The actual native body element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
